note: Kit layout in aspect-corrected normalized space (X = x * W/H, authored for 16:9, so X spans 0..1.778; Y = y). Coordinates are RAW (un-mirrored) image space. The app renders a mirrored selfie view, so screen_X = 1.778 - X: a zone at raw X 1.20 draws on the player's LEFT. The X ranges below are chosen so the MIRRORED view reads as a standard right-handed kit -- hi-hat and crash on the player's left, rack tom and ride on the right, snare centre, kick at the feet. The kit spans raw x 0.10..0.90 ON PURPOSE: MediaPipe needs a whole hand in frame to emit a landmark at all, so the outer tenth of the picture is dead space and a piece placed there cannot be hit. The centre-top is deliberately empty; that is where the player's head sits. Live camera aspect is fitted at load time (web/src/kitfit.ts), not here. Calibrate per setup (PLAN 6.1); calibration overrides these. First match in list order wins.
